hero.title: Left Hand Lucy
hero.tagline: The steady hand that makes things happen, driven by quiet and personal care.
hero.intro: I'm Lucy - an experienced Executive Assistant, event planner and organiser based in Madrid. I support businesses, and individuals with everything from day-to-day organisation to events and experiences, both remotely and in person.
hero.availability: Remote · In person in Madrid · Available to travel

image.alt: Lucy smiling on a bench in Madrid

services.label: What I Do
services.title: How I can help
services.ps_desc: When life gets busy, I can help. From admin to scheduling and task organisation, I'll help you stay on track, meet deadlines, and keep projects moving.
services.el_desc: English coaching designed to build confidence. Whether you want to improve conversation, writing, or professional communication, I adapt to your goals and learning style.
services.ee_desc: Whether you're planning a celebration or visiting Madrid for the first time, I'm your personal concierge. From curated city experiences and restaurant bookings to full event coordination — I make sure every detail is taken care of so you can simply enjoy the moment.

about.label: About Lucy
about.title: Welcome to Left Hand Lucy
about.p1: "Another string to your bow" is something I've heard often when people describe my life and career — and it perfectly sums up my journey.
about.p2: I've built a colourful career supporting High Net Worth Executives, teaching English as a Foreign Language to children and adults in Madrid, creating unforgettable events, and building strong connections along the way.
about.p3: Left Hand Lucy grew from a desire to combine my passions: supporting people with their personal and business projects, helping people gain confidence in English, and bringing people together through meaningful events.
about.p4: From handling administrative tasks seamlessly, perfecting that tricky English word or accent, to helping plan that special event, I'm here to be the extra hand you need to succeed and grow.

items.text: Lucy helps me as a VA for a few hours a week and the amount of time it gives back to me to do other things, is incredible. I couldn't be happier!
items.name: Julia Lopez
